'''R3-G5''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] in service of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. Stationed on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], it urged imperials to contact [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Annette Miran]].<ref name="Progress" />
